Daily PnL and intraday drawdown are still computed, persisted to daily_risk_state and reported (report() drops only the cap/halted fields). The latching daily-cap Telegram alert is removed because its 'No further trades today' text would be false. accounts.yaml values are unchanged (other readers: src/prop/account_rulesets.py, ml account_context).
